thresholdsInfo.method: Gumbel (L-moments) on water-year (Oct–Sep) maxima of daily values (rain: 1-day and 3-day totals)

thresholdsInfo.groundMethod: E = soil-wetness share × (liquid rain + degree-day snowmelt); Gumbel return levels of 1-day and 3-day E from ERA5
